reason: B is the better proposal because its ~5 at.% Al intervention can remain within the stated HEA compositional bounds and has a testable, evidence-supported γ/γ′ precipitation-strengthening mechanism, whereas A specifies sub-5 at.% B and 40–50 at.% Ti, directly violating those bounds. B still needs an exact baseline composition and should describe the precipitate as Al/Ti-containing L1₂ γ′ rather than generic Ni3Ti, but it more plausibly extends prior γ/γ′ findings to Ti–Ni-primary chemistry.
